# Stratton Advisory Group

> Independent health insurance advisory firm in Sunrise, Florida. Licensed broker Ayoub Cherif (Senior Advisor, NPN 22089749) compares full comprehensive health coverage (individual, family, private medically underwritten, ACA marketplace and small business group plans), plus dental and vision, from 30+ carriers for clients in 31 states. Free to the client; carriers compensate brokers. Languages: English, French and Arabic.

- Phone: (321) 442-6966
- Email: Ayoubcherifhealth@gmail.com
- Address: 1550 Sawgrass Corporate Pkwy, Sunrise, FL 33323
- Licensed states: Alabama, Arkansas, Colorado, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming
- Independent agency; not an insurance company; not affiliated with any carrier, government agency, the Health Insurance Marketplace or HealthCare.gov.
- Verify license: Florida DFS Licensee Search, NAIC State License Lookup or NIPR (NPN 22089749).

- [Family Health Insurance](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/family-health-insurance/): One plan that fits every member of your household
- [Private Health Insurance](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/private-health-insurance/): Underwritten PPO plan options

- [COBRA Alternatives](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/cobra-alternatives/): Leaving a job? Compare COBRA with other plans
- [ACA Marketplace Plans](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/aca-marketplace-insurance/): How marketplace plans compare with alternatives
- [PPO Health Insurance in Florida](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/ppo-health-insurance-florida/): How PPO plans work and where Florida PPO options are available
- [Small Business Health Benefits](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/small-business-health-insurance/): Group, level-funded and owner coverage
- [Dental & Vision Insurance](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/dental-and-vision-insurance/): Stand-alone and add-on dental and vision plans

## Health insurance guides
- [Private Health Insurance vs. ACA Marketplace Plans in Florida](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/blog/private-health-insurance-vs-aca-marketplace-florida/): The real differences between private and marketplace coverage, and how to decide which fits your health, income and doctors.
- [Health Insurance Options for Self-Employed Floridians](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/blog/health-insurance-for-self-employed-florida/): Your coverage options as a freelancer, contractor or business owner, plus how the self-employed health insurance deduction works.
- [How to Compare PPO Health Insurance Plans](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/blog/how-to-compare-ppo-health-insurance-plans/): What makes a PPO different, and the checklist we use to compare networks, out-of-network benefits and total cost.
- [Health Insurance for Florida Small Business Owners](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/blog/small-business-health-insurance-florida-guide/): Group plans, level-funded options, ICHRA and QSEHRA explained for owners with 1 to 50 employees, plus what carriers require.
- [Understanding Deductibles, Copays, and Out-of-Pocket Maximums](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/blog/deductibles-copays-out-of-pocket-maximums-explained/): Plain-language definitions, a worked example, and how to estimate what a plan will really cost you in a year.
- [How to Find Affordable Family Health Insurance in Florida](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/blog/affordable-family-health-insurance-florida/): Six practical ways Florida families lower their health insurance costs without giving up the doctors they rely on.
- [PPO vs. HMO vs. EPO: Which Plan Type Fits You?](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/blog/ppo-vs-hmo-vs-epo-florida/): The plan type decides which doctors you can see, whether you need referrals and what happens out of network. Here's how PPO, HMO, EPO and POS plans compare, and how to choose.
- [How to Choose a Health Insurance Plan in 7 Steps](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/blog/how-to-choose-a-health-insurance-plan/): A step-by-step way to pick a plan that covers your doctors, fits your budget for the whole year and doesn't surprise you later.
- [What Does a Health Insurance Broker Do?](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/blog/what-does-a-health-insurance-broker-do/): How a licensed broker helps you compare plans, how brokers get paid, and what to ask before you work with one.
- [Health Insurance for 1099 Independent Contractors](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/blog/health-insurance-for-1099-independent-contractors/): No employer plan? Here are your coverage options as a 1099 contractor, how to compare them, and the tax rules that can lower your real cost.
- [How Much Does Health Insurance Cost in Florida?](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/blog/how-much-is-health-insurance-in-florida/): Why two people can pay very different prices for coverage, what really drives your cost, and how to lower it without losing the coverage you need.
- [How to Choose a Health Insurance Broker in Florida](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/blog/how-to-choose-a-health-insurance-broker-florida/): Licensing, independence, compensation and questions to ask
- [Can I Keep My Doctor If I Change Health Insurance?](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/blog/can-i-keep-my-doctor-florida/): How to check doctors, hospitals and prescriptions before switching
- [Prescription Drug Coverage in Florida Health Insurance](https://strattonadvisorygroup.com/blog/prescription-coverage-florida-health-insurance/): Formularies, tiers, prior authorization and specialty drugs
